text:
Amy (support): heads up — Customer ACME-42 (paid Dedicated) reporting 503s and timeouts since ~08:10 UTC for ap-northeast-1. They say requests to their dedicated pool are failing to place, customer impact ~30% of traffic. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-987

Amy (support): sample error from their side: `failed to place allocation: no compatible instance found` and our API returns `AllocationThrottleError` with 429 spikes. Customer is pushing higher qps to start of day, claims autoscale didn't keep up. Escalation level: P1 (customer-facing SLA).

Laura (prod-eng): thx, pulling logs from placement service. Do we have the autoscaler events for that pool? send pool id pl-88a2.

Raj (ml-ops): I see repeated scale-up attempts for pl-88a2 between 08:05-08:20 but VMs reported `registry: capacity-exhausted` from the cloud provider. Autoscaler retried but backoff increased. Looks like allocation API returned 409/503 from provider.

Mateo (capacity): ap-ne region inventory was low — we had maintenance on AZ-a last night; spare reserve reduced. capacity-bot flagged low-gpu-available at 07:40 UTC.

capacity-bot: alert: region=ap-northeast-1, available_gpus=22, threshold=30, reserved=6

Kevin (oncall-sre): immediate mitigation options: 1) failover traffic for pl-88a2 to eu-west1 (same latency ~+40ms) via routing policy, 2) temporary bump dedicated throttle quota for ACME-42, 3) attempt noisy-tenant isolation on existing nodes. Which do we want to do now?

Amy (support): customer wants fastest recovery; they're OK with eu-west failover if we explain. Prefer routing first, then repro and long-term fix. I'll message ACME-42 about temporary region failover.

Laura (prod-eng): I'll prepare a canary route. Need a signed off runbook step: `route-dedicated --pool pl-88a2 --to-region eu-west1 --retain-kvcache false` (this will cause cold starts but restores service). Can someone review?

Raj (ml-ops): note: kv cache disable will increase token cost but acceptable short-term. Also we should capture a heap of debug traces — add `X-Debug-IDs` from their failed requests so we can trace placement attempts. Amy can you paste a few trace ids?

Amy (support): pasted two traces from customer logs: `trace=8a3f2c`, `trace=8a3f9d`. Also their request ids: `req=acme-0001`, `req=acme-0002`. Sent them the intended failover plan.

Laura (prod-eng): doing a dry-run routing change on staging routing table, then will apply to prod. deploy-bot report follows.

deploy-bot: deploy started for routemap/pl-88a2 -> eu-west1 by laura (prod-eng) at 08:36 UTC

Laura (prod-eng): applied routing override. Monitoring.

Kevin (oncall-sre): routing change applied. Confirming traffic shift: currently 70% routed to eu-west1, 30% still trying ap-ne. Latency for eu-west path looks +45ms.

Amy (support): customer reports traffic recovery to 99% and errors dropped. They see increased latency but acceptable. They requested a postmortem and root cause.

Mateo (capacity): short term notes: we need to replenish ap-ne spare capacity and revisit maintenance windows. Raising provisioning priority for ap-ne AZ-a. I'll open capacity ticket to cloud partner.

Raj (ml-ops): for root cause — autoscaler retry/backoff masked provider-side allocation failures (provider returned 503 vs clear OOM). We should add provider error classification and accelerate fallback to cross-region placement when allocation rate > X.

Laura (prod-eng): agree. Action items: 1) postmortem (Laura) 2) capacity repro and provider ticket (Mateo) 3) autoscaler tuning + error classifier (Raj) 4) customer comms + credits (Amy)

Amy (support): filed customer follow-up email and credited one day of Dedicated uptime as goodwill.

Kevin (oncall-sre): we also found a noisy-tenant signature on two nodes in the pool — likely caused eviction flapping. I isolated and cordoned those nodes. Will watch for recurrence.

Laura (prod-eng): saving logs and knitting together timeline. Will include the `capacity-bot` alert and the two trace ids.

Mateo (capacity): created cloud ticket CT-542 (provider resource exhaustion in ap-northeast-1) and scheduled emergency capacity refill for AZ-a. ETA 6 hours.

Raj (ml-ops): small repro to exercise throttling locally (for engineering):

```
# repro: simulate heavy placement & provider 503
ab --n 1000 -c 100 https://internal-placement.api/pl-88a2/alloc
# observe backoff and 429 AllocationThrottleError
```

Laura (prod-eng): thanks team. I'll start the postmortem draft and tag leads. Closing thread after postmortem created. :white_check_mark:

Amy (support): marking customer ticket as resolved for now. Will attach notes and keep watch for 24h.

Kevin (oncall-sre): left: verify autoscaler metrics alert thresholds and add fallback runbook. I'll follow up in the postmortem.

Laura (prod-eng): end.
